decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster sits at the core of the firm's coolant-management business, its prospects are still unfolding after a 2023 launch, and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
Coolant nozzles are a cheap multi-model accessory line that supports system sales, so holding the option costs little even after the portfolio was pruned.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple with steady metalworking demand, and nothing so far suggests their value will not be realized.
The magnetic belt conveyor shares the established conveyor platform, so keeping it costs little, and with the hinged belt variant dropped it fills a distinct niche.
